description:
Create a Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID) for a Steam Heater Control Loop based on the specifications in '~/Desktop/pid_specs.txt'.

1. Read the specifications file to understand the process requirements.
2. Enable the 'Process Engineering' (or 'PID') shape library in draw.io (found under 'More Shapes').
3. Create the diagram showing:
   - Heat Exchanger (Tag: HX-200)
   - Temperature Transmitter (Tag: TT-201) on the outlet
   - Temperature Indicator Controller (Tag: TIC-201)
   - Control Valve (Tag: TV-201) on the steam inlet
   - Process lines connecting these components to form a feedback control loop
4. Label all components with their Tag Numbers.
5. Save the source file to '~/Desktop/heat_exchanger_pid.drawio' and export a PNG to '~/Desktop/heat_exchanger_pid.png'.
